info.name: LJVIS — Cron Jobs (LJVIS2-12, LJVIS2-56/69, LJVIS2-135/58/23)
info.description: Functional tests for the CronManager-triggered batch endpoints: nightly user deactivation (LJVIS2-12), nightly e-toimik decision sync + auto-publish (LJVIS2-56/LJVIS2-69), hourly yvkehtivus sync (LJVIS2-135/58/23), and nightly risk-score recalculation (LJVIS2-150/151/152). No auth needed — all endpoints under test are either Ruuter.internal (no session) or Resql called directly. XTR is not part of the CI stack (no certs/secrets available there), so e-toimik/yvkehtivus are tested at the Resql layer, which is where the real bugs were found (latest-snapshot-vs-filter resolution order, idempotency guards, not clobbering manually-entered fields); the X-Road round-trip was verified manually against the real ee-dev sandbox instead (see .ai/future-plans/etoimik-vaarteomenetlus-nightly.md and cronmanager-scheduled-jobs.md). The etoimik/yvkehtivus resilience folder regression-tests that a bad candidate never takes the whole ruuter-internal process down, using the CI stack's absence of `xtr` as the fault condition — the risk-score-recalc block doesn't need that folder at all, since it calls Ruuter.internal's own `risk-scores/recalculate` endpoint (no XTR dependency).
